summary: Masbate 3rd District representative with 61 principal-authored bills. Authored higher minimum pay for private-sector professionals, a standard entry-level salary for registered professionals and travel-tax abolition. Co-authored the national minimum wage, a daily wage increase, cash aid for first-time employees, fuel-tax relief and a temporary diesel price ceiling.
caveat: Most items beyond the two wage bills are co-authored. Diesel price ceiling is a market intervention but a single co-authored bill.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored higher minimum pay and a standardized entry salary for professionals (-2); co-authored national minimum wage, first-job cash aid and a diesel price ceiling (-2 to -3), against travel tax abolition and fuel tax relief (+1 to 0).
